description: Hand-written per-feature inventory for the Material GitLab site. Statuses describe the current repository only; unverified evidence is never presented as shipped proof.

implementation.assertion: English, Traditional Chinese and bilingual controls are implemented on the site settings surface.

documentation.assertion: The language-mode article is declared for the offline documentation set.

localization.assertion: Generic language-mode labels have English, Traditional Chinese and bilingual entries.

persistence.assertion: The selected language mode is persisted in visitor-local storage.

evidence.assertion: A future evidence record must name the built commit and verification state.

features.label: Independent English and Cantonese funny-level controls

implementation.assertion: Independent English and Cantonese level-one-to-five controls are wired to rendered copy.

documentation.assertion: The funny-level article is declared for the offline documentation set.

localization.assertion: Funny-level labels and disclosure copy have all three language modes.

persistence.assertion: Both language-specific funny levels persist independently.

evidence.assertion: A future record must show both controls in the built site.

features.label: Show emojis in dialogs and message boxes

implementation.assertion: The emoji preference is reachable and changes semantic dialog decoration.

documentation.assertion: The emoji-toggle article is declared for offline docs.

localization.assertion: Emoji-toggle copy is available in English, Traditional Chinese and bilingual modes.

persistence.assertion: The emoji preference persists locally.

evidence.assertion: A future record must distinguish enabled and disabled states.

implementation.assertion: A shared renameable mode suppresses non-English features until locally unlocked.

documentation.assertion: The School mode article is declared for offline docs.

localization.assertion: The chosen display name and unlock copy are localized without leaking a private mapping.

persistence.assertion: Mode, name and unlock state use shared visitor-local storage.

evidence.assertion: A future record must show live propagation and reset behavior.

documentation.assertion: The narration article is declared for offline docs.

localization.assertion: Narration language, voice and fallback status copy is localized.

persistence.assertion: Stable voice identities, rate and pitch persist locally.

evidence.assertion: A future record must identify runtime voice enumeration and verification.

localization.assertion: Schedule and external-source status strings have all three language modes.

persistence.assertion: Versioned schedule state is stored in visitor-local storage.

evidence.assertion: A future record must name timezone and source verification.

documentation.assertion: The surprise article is declared for offline docs.

localization.assertion: Surprise framing supports English, Traditional Chinese and bilingual modes.

persistence.assertion: The launch draw does not persist a disabling preference or private payload.

evidence.assertion: A future record must name the public catalog revision and asset.

documentation.assertion: The regex article is declared for offline docs.

localization.assertion: Builder labels and validation messages have all three language modes.

persistence.assertion: Pattern, flags and enabled state are retained per search surface.

evidence.assertion: A future record must identify each search surface and verification state.

localization.assertion: Notification titles, bodies and dismiss labels have all three language modes.

persistence.assertion: Notification history is persisted without private vocabulary values.
